instruction: Complete the model in the opened Autodesk Revit environment using its automation interfaces, then export it to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. For this workflow, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is an open maker workshop with a regular exposed column rhythm. Operations staff need a small office and tool store along the east side, while the open workshop floor and structural grid remain legible.
source: Autodesk Revit 2025 API and IFC exporter

command: import pyautogui, time; pyautogui.FAILSAFE=False; time.sleep(35); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(10); pyautogui.press('enter')
